extracted.name: Daal dhokli
instruction_lines: Soak the lentil for 30 minutes and have 4 whistles properly by adding double estimated water and peanut
Add salt and turmeric when turn the gas to boil the lentil
Now roast them and add tomatoes with all the left spices together
Now simmer the tadka for 10 minutes.
Take all purpose flour and mix carom seeds,pinch of salt,black pepper,turmeric and oil
Now mix with the help of water and make a hard dough
Rest for 15 minutes and after that make flat thin layer and cut the diamond shape small pieces
Now boil the lentil and whisk openly.add these diamond shaped pieces and jaggery piece.boil openly for 10 to 15 minutes
